Support Partnerships Branch knowledge management by capturing best practices, lessons learned, engagement outcomes, decision points, recurring requirements, and continuity products to improve branch efficiency and corporate memory. 7. Conduct geopolitical, regional, and strategic analysis on Partner Nations and partnership frameworks, within an allocated portfolio of countries, to inform ACT planning, engagement, and senior leader decision-making. Contractor 3 — Defence Planning Integration and Partnership Framework Implementation 1.
